logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of metal-based drug was measured using the shake flask technology. An equal volume of octanol and water mixture containing the complex was vibrated on a shaker for 24 h. the two phases of water and octanol were collected. 50μL of the obtained substance was dissolve in 1000 μL HNO3, and then diluted with distilled water. The lipophilicity was determined by ICP-MS.
